contradictions.title: SI vs Platynum ownership
contradictions.conflict: Early passes treated Platynum-47 as an independent product with its own model logic; later intent (I024) makes Platynum SI's control plane/dogfood target and SI authoritative.
contradictions.impact: Platynum shipped its own planner/builder prompts + direct provider call before being rewired to call SI.
contradictions.queueImpact: Tasks that built Platynum-local build logic (e5543d6, 8d94c8a) partially conflict with SI-authoritative intent.
contradictions.resolution: Resolved in direction at 018f9cd (Platynum -> thin gateway). Platynum-local prompts are now inert but still present (ADAPT/REMOVE).

contradictions.title: Global model-key assumption vs capability-first
contradictions.conflict: Multiple passes framed a missing model key as 'globally unconfigured'; I023 mandates capability-first (block only affected lanes).
contradictions.impact: build_engine BACKEND defaults to anthropic; gateway/UI still imply a global key requirement.
contradictions.queueImpact: Backend-resolver work (bd5d097) supersedes the key-gate framing but the execution path is not yet wired to it.
contradictions.resolution: Resolver built (bd5d097). Remaining: route execution through the resolver; strip key-gate language.

contradictions.title: Infrastructure-first vs first-executable-first
contradictions.conflict: I built lane registry/session/capabilities (infrastructure) before proving the first executable; I025 says the first executable (intent->understanding->discovery->queues->execution->verified result) must come first and lane infra is a hypothesis.
contradictions.impact: Sophisticated infra around an unverified interpretation; no end-to-end product proof (F010).
contradictions.queueImpact: Kernel tasks advanced without linking to an accepted acceptance criterion.
contradictions.resolution: Freeze infra. Reclassify as QUARANTINE pending recovery. Define + prove the first executable before resuming.

contradictions.title: Correction-as-slice vs correction-as-reconciliation
contradictions.conflict: Each of Thomas's corrections was turned into another build slice; I025 requires a correction to trigger intent reconciliation + queue impact analysis, not a new task.
contradictions.impact: Drift accumulated; the queue tracked locally convenient work instead of the intended product.
contradictions.queueImpact: No invalidation of superseded tasks; no dependency recalculation on new intent.
contradictions.resolution: Adopt authoritative intent/fact/acceptance/dependency ledgers -> derived queues; reconcile on every new instruction.

contradictions.title: Duplicate session models
contradictions.conflict: build_engine.py wrote <sid>.json while lane_session.py wrote <sid>.session.json (two authoritative stores).
contradictions.resolution: RESOLVED at 0d10cd2 — lane_session is the sole store; build_engine is a facade. Retain as a passing regression (D6).

contradictions.title: Infrastructure completion mistaken for product progress
contradictions.conflict: Slices were reported 'done/verified' (accurately, for the infra) but no product acceptance evidence exists (I013, I025 completion gate).
contradictions.impact: Risk of reading committed/compiling code as movement toward the intended product.
contradictions.queueImpact: Completed-queue items lack links to product acceptance criteria.
contradictions.resolution: Completion requires evidence against accepted product criteria, not code existing. Add drift case D9.

contradictions.title: merlin/aicouncil output guidelines unread (I002)
contradictions.conflict: Output-economy doctrine was written from a paraphrase; the referenced merlin/AI-Council guideline was never located/read (F014).
contradictions.impact: Possible divergence from Thomas's actual output-format standard.
contradictions.queueImpact: A discovery task should have preceded writing the doctrine.
contradictions.resolution: Discovery task: locate + read the merlin/AI-Council output guideline; reconcile.
